messages:
Sasha: Kicking off EU6 region onboarding. Need cloud account/project + VPC scaffold for GPU fleet (A100/H100). Goal: template + validation runbook so EngInfra can hand off to Cloud-SRE for final apply.

Aj: Great — what's your proposed CIDR plan? We need non-overlapping with eu3 and peering CIDRs.

Sasha: Proposal: VPC CIDR 10.40.0.0/16, prod subnets in 10.40.1.0/24..10.40.4.0/24 (zone aware), shared-services 10.40.10.0/24, mgmt 10.40.20.0/24. Public NAT gateway subnets should be /28 per AZ. Keep room for nodepools + private prefixes.

Maria: +1 on those ranges. Also add reserved /22 for future GPU pool expansion (10.40.32.0/22). I'll attach the terraform module link: https://git.internal/redwood/terraform-modules/vpc (use v2.4.1).

infra-bot: RUNBOOK CREATED: https://runbooks.internal/redwood/region-onboard — checklist generated: account IAM, required APIs enabled, org policy scan, KMS/HSM key, network ACLs, flow logs, VPC DNS, and peering preflight.

Devon: Raising quota ticket for GPUs now. Requesting: 16x A100-80GB and 8x H100 initially, with compute quota and regional GPU quota bump. Ticket #INC-4582.

Aj: For routing to on-prem, do we want Transit GW + BGP or Cloud Interconnect? EU6 will use Transit Gateway + VPN fallback per compliance. Need to ensure route propagation from TGW to VPC and correct route filter.

Sasha: Yes — TGW with BGP, advertise private ASN 64512. Add route propagation and disable auto-assigned public IPs for node pools. Also enable flow logs to central logging project.

Maria: Terraform apply steps I suggest:
```
cd infra/regions/eu6
terraform init -backend-config=backend-eu6.tfvars
terraform plan -var-file=eu6.tfvars
terraform apply -var-file=eu6.tfvars
```
Tag resources with `team:eng-infra`, `env:prod`, `owner:sasha`. Use module version v2.4.1 and run `terraform validate` before plan.

cloud-sre-oncall: I'll schedule a dry-run next Tue 09:00 UTC for a non-prod account. Will validate peering, NAT behavior, and kube node provisioning. Ping me when quotas are granted.

Sasha: OK — I'll update the region onboarding doc with CIDRs, quota ticket link, and attach a minimal nodepool spec (K8s provider agnostic). Will post the preflight checklist here once done. Thanks :thumbsup:

Aj: quick note — remember to include firewall rule to allow mgmt bastion (ssh) from trusted admin IPs and lock down metadata server access on nodes. Also add egress deny-by-default and explicit allow lists for telemetry endpoints.

Sasha: noted, adding firewall examples and IAM roles. Cost heads-up: rough baseline estimate ~ $40k/mo with reserved capacity and 99th percentile padding. Final cost depends on committed nodes and burst policy. Last action: I'll hand off TF vars and apply plan after dry-run passes.
